# Bloub engine source

This directory vendors the framework-free avatar engine from
[jeremy-prt/bloub](https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub) at commit
`b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749`.

Vendored modules are the minimal source closure used by Ziggy's React avatar:
`engine`, `decor`, `expressions`, `eyefit`, `face`, `math`, `shape`,
`states`, `profiles`, `skins`, and `repere`. The upstream Vue application is
not included. The source remains available under the MIT license in [LICENSE](./LICENSE).
